# DumbJ keymap

<!-- Generated from keymaps/ by dumbj-actions. Do not edit by hand. -->

Linux uses the `macOS For All` keymap and macOS uses IntelliJ's `Mac OS X 10.5+` keymap.

| Action | DumbJ ID | IntelliJ ID | Linux | macOS |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Open Folder… | `project.open-folder` | `OpenFile` | — | — |
| Close Tab | `tabs.close` | `CloseContent` | `Ctrl+W` | `⌘W` |
| Select Next Tab | `tabs.next` | `NextTab` | `Ctrl+Shift+]` | `⇧⌘]` / `⌃Right` |
| Select Previous Tab | `tabs.previous` | `PreviousTab` | `Ctrl+Shift+[` | `⇧⌘[` / `⌃Left` |
| Project Tool Window | `tool-window.project` | `ActivateProjectToolWindow` | `Alt+1` | `⌘1` |
| Hide All Tool Windows | `tool-window.hide-all` | `HideAllWindows` | `Ctrl+Shift+F12` | `⇧⌘F12` |
| Go to Line:Column… | `editor.goto-line` | `GotoLine` | `Ctrl+L` | `⌘L` |
| Find… | `editor.find` | `Find` | `Ctrl+F` | `⌘F` |
| Find Next | `editor.find-next` | `FindNext` | `Ctrl+G` | `⌘G` |
| Find Previous | `editor.find-previous` | `FindPrevious` | `Alt+Shift+G` | `⇧⌘G` |
| Extend Selection | `editor.extend-selection` | `EditorSelectWord` | `Alt+Up` | `⌥Up` |
